title: No other trade; his father a foreman at D.H. Holmes
summary: Harris only worked as a musician; his father was foreman of the laundry at D.H. Holmes.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: We'd go all day long, come down and take a bath, boom in the car, we'd go on again. Did you ever have any other trade besides your music?
Did your father do anything else?
No, that's all he did. He was a foreman at D.H. Holmes.
Yeah, he was a foreman at D.H. Holmes. He used to run that laundry department.
